question.text: Anand submits a valid redemption request at 2:00 PM on Wednesday. Applying the general 3-working-day redemption timeline supported by the Series II-B workbook (no intervening holidays), by when should he receive the redemption proceeds?

explanation.text: The Logic: The Series II-B workbook (pages 186 and 192) supports a 3-working-day timeline for payment/dispatch of redemption proceeds from the receipt of a valid transaction request. With the request received on Wednesday (T) and no intervening holidays, the working days are Thursday (T+1), Friday (T+2) and the following Monday (T+3), so proceeds should reach the investor by Monday. The Trap: Candidates may use a shorter cycle such as T+1 or T+2 by mixing in category-specific assumptions. The pages checked support T+3 working days as the general timeline. Note: When working backwards from a client's liquidity deadline, count working days only and add any intervening holidays.
